web-guide-idea-30.audience: People who relax more easily in a familiar Indian language.
web-guide-idea-30.offer: Offer a chai-length conversation in a language you speak naturally. Everyday humour, expressions and shared cultural references are the experience.
web-guide-idea-30.steps.0: Ask which language and topics feel comfortable.
web-guide-idea-30.steps.1: Start with a light prompt about food, hometowns or the week.
web-guide-idea-30.steps.2: Leave room for the guest’s stories and end on time.
web-guide-idea-30.equipment: A camera phone, earphones and a quiet room. Your cup of chai is atmosphere, not required equipment.
web-guide-idea-30.returnReason: Use fresh prompts and dependable availability. Familiar language can make the next conversation feel welcoming.
web-guide-idea-30.promotion: Record a short introduction in the language you offer so people can hear your style before booking.

web-guide-idea-30.metadataDescription: Have a relaxed conversation in Hindi, Tamil, Bengali, Marathi or another language that feels like home. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
